AND ( s.shelter_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND c.care_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.care_status = 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
CASE WHEN DATE(c.care_date) >= CURDATE() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN DATE(c.care_date) >= CURDATE() THEN c.care_date END ASC, CASE WHEN DATE(c.care_date) < CURDATE() THEN c.care_date END DESC,
c.care_number DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT c.care_number, c.user_number, c.care_title, c.care_post, c.care_date, c.care_recruit, u.user_nickname, c.care_write_date, c.care_status, COUNT(a.apply_number) AS apply_count FROM ddd_care c JOIN ddd_user u ON c.user_number = u.user_number LEFT JOIN ddd_care_apply a ON c.care_number = a.care_number WHERE c.care_number = #{careNumber} AND c.care_status IN ('open', 'closed') GROUP BY c.care_number, c.user_number, c.care_title, c.care_post, c.care_date, c.care_recruit, u.user_nickname, c.care_write_date, c.care_status

INSERT INTO ddd_care_apply (care_number, user_number, apply_date) SELECT #{careNumber}, #{userNumber}, NOW() FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ddd_care c WHERE c.care_number = #{careNumber} AND c.care_status = 'open' AND DATE(c.care_date) >= CURDATE() AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ddd_care_apply a WHERE a.care_number = c.care_number ) < c.care_recruit )
mapper.update: UPDATE ddd_care SET apply_count = apply_count + 1 WHERE care_number = #{careNumber} AND care_status = 'open'
UPDATE ddd_care c SET c.care_status = 'closed' WHERE c.care_number = #{careNumber} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ddd_care_apply a WHERE a.care_number = c.care_number ) >= c.care_recruit

UPDATE ddd_care c SET c.care_status = 'open' WHERE c.care_number = #{careNumber} AND DATE(c.care_date) >= CURDATE() AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ddd_care_apply a WHERE a.care_number = c.care_number ) < c.care_recruit AND c.care_status <> 'deleted'

SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(a.apply_number), '/', c.care_recruit) AS apply_status FROM ddd_care c LEFT JOIN ddd_care_apply a ON c.care_number = a.care_number WHERE c.care_number = #{careNumber} GROUP BY c.care_recruit
SELECT user_number FROM ddd_care WHERE care_number = #{careNumber} AND care_status <> 'deleted'
mapper.update: UPDATE ddd_care c SET c.care_status = CASE WHEN c.care_status = 'deleted' THEN 'deleted' WHEN DATE(c.care_date) < CURDATE() THEN 'closed' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ddd_care_apply a WHERE a.care_number = c.care_number ) >= c.care_recruit THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END WHERE c.care_number = #{careNumber} AND c.care_status <> 'deleted'
